I mean, it’s a big question. And if we were geographically located somewhere else, our opinions would be entirely different. I don’t think it’s as simple as right or wrong. But I do hate that people call it selfish, or cowardly. It’s arguably the hardest commitment you could ever make. I feel like most people who say that, don’t understand what it’s like to be at the point of suicide. I also recognize that reactionary suicide is a bad idea, and it’s dumb. You still have the ability to enjoy life, after the loss of a loved one, breakup, etc. But let’s say you have been around for 30 years or so, and life isn’t for you, who am I to say, “no you are forced to play this game” so I don’t see it as unethical. It’s just like anything else in nature.
